description.en:
* This field and the body field are mutually exclusive; you must provide one and only one.  
* Image URL (must not exceed 2048 bytes; base64 is not supported).

description.zh:
* 本字段和URL字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
* 图片二进制文件，最大10MB。
* 使用HTTP方式调用，把图片二进制文件放到HTTP body中上传即可。
* 使用SDK的方式调用，把图片放到SDK的body中即可。
description.en:
* This field and the URL field are mutually exclusive; you must provide one and only one.  
* Binary file of the image, up to 10 MB.  
* When invoking via HTTP, upload the binary file of the image in the HTTP body.  
* When invoking via the software development kit (SDK), place the image in the SDK body.

descriptions.zh:
#### 本接口适用场景 * 阿里云口算判题识别，是阿里云官方自研OCR文字识别产品，适用于整数的加减乘除四则运算、整数的混合运算、大小比较、最大数最小数等的场景。 * 阿里云OCR产品基于阿里巴巴达摩院强大的AI技术及海量数据，历经多年沉淀打磨，具有服务稳定、操作简易、实时性高、能力全面等几大优势。 * 本接口图片示例

#### 本接口核心能力 |分类 |概述| |---|---------| |图像增强|默认支持图像增强，包括图像自动旋转、畸变自动矫正、模糊图片自动增强等能力。| |多类型覆盖|支持模糊、光照不均、透视畸变、任意背景等低质量图像识别。| |高精度识别|总体识别准确率可达97%。| #### 如何使用本接口 |步骤|概述| |--|---| |1|开通 [教育场景识别](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_education_public_cn) 服务。开通服务前后，您可以通过[体验馆](https://duguang.aliyun.com/experience?type=edu&subtype=kousuan#intro)免费体验本功能识别效果。| |2|购买[教育场景识别资源包](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_education_dp_cn&request=%7B%22ord_time%22:%221:Year%22,%22order_num%22:1,%22pack%22:%22ocr_education_dp_cn_20211103164555_0373%22,%22flowout_spec%22:%22500%22%7D)。本API会赠送免费额度，可使用免费额度测试。| |3|可以参照[调试页面](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/ocr-api/2021-07-07/RecognizeEduOralCalculation?sdkStyle=dara)提供的代码示例完成API接入开发。接入完成后，调用API获取识别结果。如果使用子账号调用接口，需要阿里云账号（主账号）对RAM账号进行授权。创建RAM用户的具体操作，请参考：[创建RAM用户。](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93720.html)文字识别服务提供一种系统授权策略，即**AliyunOCRFullAccess**。具体授权操作，请参见[在用户页面为RAM用户授权。](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116146.html)| #### 重要提示 |类型|概述| |----|-------------------| |图片格式|
  • 本接口支持：PNG、JPG、JPEG、BMP、GIF、TIFF、WebP。暂不支持PDF格式。
| |图片尺寸|
  • 图片长宽需要大于15像素，小于8192像素。
  • 长宽比需要小于50。
  • 如需达到较好识别效果，建议长宽均大于500px。
| |图片大小|
  • 图片二进制文件不能超过10MB。
  • 图片过大会影响接口响应速度，建议使用小于1.5M图片进行识别，且通过传图片URL的方式调用接口。
| |其他提示|
  • 接口响应速度和图片中的文字数量有关，如果图片中文字数量越多，接口响应可能越慢。
  • 接口会自动处理反光、扭曲等干扰信息，但会影响精度。请尽量选择清晰度高、无反光、无扭曲的图片。
| |相关能力|
  • [云市场口算判题。](https://market.aliyun.com/products/57124001/cmapi00043293.html?#sku=yuncode3729300001)
|
descriptions.en:
#### Scenarios for This API * Alibaba Cloud Oral Calculation Grading Recognition is an OCR text recognition product independently developed by Alibaba Cloud. It is suitable for scenarios involving basic operations (addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division) on integers, mixed integer operations, comparisons of magnitude, and identification of maximum or minimum values. * Based on DAMO Academy’s advanced AI technologies and massive datasets, Alibaba Cloud's OCR products have been refined over years to offer high stability, ease of use, real-time performance, and comprehensive capabilities. * Sample image for this API:

#### Core Capabilities of This API | Categorization | Overview | |---|---------| | Image Enhancement | Supports automatic image enhancement by default, including automatic rotation, distortion correction, and enhancement of blurry images. | | Multi-type Coverage | Supports recognition of low-quality images, such as those that are blurry, unevenly lit, perspective-distorted, or set against arbitrary backgrounds. | | High-Precision Recognition | Achieves an overall recognition accuracy rate of up to 97%. | #### How to Use This API | Step | Overview | |--|---| | 1 | Activate the [Education Scenario Recognition](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_education_public_cn) service. Before or after activation, you can freely test the recognition performance of this feature via the [Experience Center](https://duguang.aliyun.com/experience?type=edu&subtype=kousuan#intro). | | 2 | Purchase an [Education Scenario Recognition resource plan](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_education_dp_cn&request=%7B%22ord_time%22:%221:Year%22,%22order_num%22:1,%22pack%22:%22ocr_education_dp_cn_20211103164555_0373%22,%22flowout_spec%22:%22500%22%7D). This API provides a free quota for testing purposes. | | 3 | Refer to the code samples provided on the [debug page](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/ocr-api/2021-07-07/RecognizeEduOralCalculation?sdkStyle=dara) to integrate the API into your application. After integration, invoke the API to retrieve classification results. If you use a RAM user to call this API, the Alibaba Cloud account (primary account) must grant authorization to the RAM user. For instructions on creating a RAM user, see [Create a RAM User](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93720.html). The OCR service provides a system authorization policy named **AliyunOCRFullAccess**. For detailed steps on granting permissions, see [Authorize a RAM User on the User Page](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116146.html). | #### Important Notes | Type | Overview | |----|-------------------| | Image Format |
  • This API supports PNG, JPG, JPEG, BMP, GIF, TIFF, and WebP formats. PDF format is not currently supported.
| | Image Dimensions |
  • Both height and width must be greater than 15 pixels and less than 8192 pixels.
  • The aspect ratio (longer side divided by shorter side) must be less than 50.
  • To achieve optimal recognition results, we recommend using images with both dimensions exceeding 500 pixels.
| | Image Size |
  • The binary file size of the image must not exceed 10 MB.
  • Larger images may slow down API response times. We recommend using images smaller than 1.5 MB and invoking the API by passing an image URL.
| | Additional Tips |
  • API response time depends on the number of characters in the image; more characters may lead to slower responses.
  • The API automatically handles interference such as glare and distortion, though this may affect accuracy. Please use images with high definition, minimal glare, and no distortion whenever possible.
| | Related Features |
  • [Alibaba Cloud Marketplace Oral Calculation Grading](https://market.aliyun.com/products/57124001/cmapi00043293.html?#sku=yuncode3729300001)
|
